children: Valion Bio highlighted Velocity Bioworks' San Antonio CDMO capabilities to support early-phase U.S. biologics manufacturing amid new Section 232 tariffs.
Velocity Bioworks offers process development, analytical services and GMP drug substance manufacturing for early clinical programs.
San Antonio site supports microbial GMP scales up to 200L and mammalian capabilities for early clinical development.
Announcement positioned as response to Section 232 tariffs that may increase demand for U.S.-based pharmaceutical manufacturing.
Velocity aims to support Valion’s Entolimod program and external partners to improve supply-chain control, cost and timelines.
